Memax V2 engineering brief
Every line cites a memory.

Decisions
- Background jobs run on River, Postgres-backed. We do not use Temporal. [M-0219]

Conventions
- pnpm workspaces only. Never run `npm install` at the root. [M-0071]

Live context
Use the memax connector for anything not here: search_memories, get_memory. Propose new memories with save_memory.
